description: E-Hentai gallery page (/g///) as served to a logged-out visitor: div.gm with #gd1 cover as a div whose inline style is 'background:transparent url(https://ehgt.org/...) no-repeat' (no , no OpenGraph, no JSON-LD), #gn English heading with bracketed lead/tail, #gj Japanese heading, #gdc category div 'Doujinshi', #gdn uploader link, #gdd table (Posted/Parent/Visible/Language with TR badge/File Size/Length '46 pages'/Favorited), rating map, #taglist rows td.tc 'language:' 'parody:' 'character:' 'group:' 'artist:' 'female:' 'male:' 'other:' with div.gt/div.gtl > a href=https://e-hentai.org/tag/ns:name+with+plus. Traps: 'Showing 1 - 40 of 46 images' pagination (pages must be 46, not 40); 40 thumbnail sprites in #gdt that are ALSO inline background:url(https://ehgt.org/m/...) divs (not the cover); a #gnd 'newer version' box with another gallery's title and an 'added 2024-05-20' date; Parent row linking another gid; the scanlator '[Quill Xbyx]' in the title tail and uploader 'quill_xbyx' (neither is a group/artist); comments auto-linking https://e-hentai.org/tag/artist:quill+xbcf and quoting 'female:tanlines' as plain text; language:english / language:translated rows. Unsure of: the 2024 thumbnail grid shape (#gdt.gt100 > a > div with sprite background; older pages used div.gdtm > div > a > img), whether #gd5 is wrapped in #gright, the exact placement of #gnd, the #gdo options block, the footer links and the ad snippet; the gallery itself (names, gid/token, hashes) is invented.
